}}'''Rabayn Marushta''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|5}}. She was the first Amyrlin Seat raised in the [[New Era]].

==History==
Rabayn held the position for thirty-one years until her death in {{Ne|36}}. She was [[Selame Necoine]]'s successor and [[Dalaine Ndaye]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was a quite weak Amyrlin, not a puppet of the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] but definitely not in true control of the situation.
